arxiv-1806-04330.title: Neural Network Models for Paraphrase Identification, Semantic Textual Similarity, Natural Language Inference, and Question Answering
arxiv-1806-04330.creator: Wuwei Lan, Wei Xu
arxiv-1806-04330.description: Abstract In this paper, we analyze several neural network designs (and their variations) for sentence pair modeling and compare their performance extensively across eight datasets, including paraphrase identification, semantic textual similarity, natural language inference, and question answering tasks. Although most of these models have claimed state-of-the-art performance, the original papers often reported on only one or two selected datasets.

arxiv-2105-03383.title: High transmission in twisted bilayer graphene with angle disorder
arxiv-2105-03383.creator: Héctor Sainz-Cruz, Tommaso Cea, Pierre A. Pantaleón, Francisco Guinea
arxiv-2105-03383.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Héctor Sainz-Cruz, Tommaso Cea, Pierre A. Pantaleón, Francisco Guinea. Angle disorder is an intrinsic feature of twisted bilayer graphene and other moiré materials. Here, we discuss electron transport in twisted bilayer graphene in the presence of angle disorder. We compute the local density of states and the Landauer-Büttiker transmission through an angle disorder barrier of width comparable to the moiré period, using a decimation technique based on a real space description.

arxiv-2107-11360.title: Laughlin states change under large geometry deformations and imaginary time Hamiltonian dynamics
arxiv-2107-11360.creator: Gabriel Matos, Bruno Mera, José M. Mourão, Paulo D. Mourão, João P. Nunes
arxiv-2107-11360.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Gabriel Matos, Bruno Mera, José M. Mourão, Paulo D. Mourão, João P. Nunes. We study the change of the Laughlin states under large deformations of the geometry of the sphere and the plane, associated with Mabuchi geodesics on the space of metrics with Hamiltonian S 1 S^{1} –symmetry.

arxiv-2205-03025.title: Resonance nucleon scattering amplitude in the photonuclear reaction
arxiv-2205-03025.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . The cross section of the photonuclear reaction in the nucleon-resonance region is calculated to search the resonance-nucleon scattering amplitude in the nucleus. It is assumed that the resonance R R is produced and decayed in the elementary photon-nucleon ( γ ​ N ) (\gamma N) reaction in the nucleus as γ ​ N → R → γ ​ N \gamma N\to R\to\gamma N . The resonance interacts with the nucleons while propagating through the nucleus.

arxiv-2210-06381.title: Good Intentions, Bad Inventions: How Employees Judge Pervasive Technologies in the Workplace
arxiv-2210-06381.creator: Marios Constantinides, Daniele Quercia
arxiv-2210-06381.description: Abstract Pervasive technologies combined with powerful AI have been recently introduced to enhance work productivity. Yet, some of these technologies are judged to be invasive. To identify which ones, we should understand how employees tend to judge these technologies. We considered 16 technologies that track productivity, and conducted a study in which 131 crowd-workers judged these scenarios.

arxiv-2303-12420.title: Use of vector polarizability to manipulate alkali-metal atoms
arxiv-2303-12420.creator: D. Cho
arxiv-2303-12420.description: Abstract We review a few ideas and experiments that our laboratory at Korea University has proposed and carried out to use vector polarizability β \beta to manipulate alkali-metal atoms. β \beta comes from spin-orbit coupling, and it produces an ac Stark shift that resembles a Zeeman shift.

arxiv-2408-00067.title: Monopole Breaking of Chern-Weil Symmetries
arxiv-2408-00067.creator: Eduardo García-Valdecasas, Matthew Reece, Motoo Suzuki
arxiv-2408-00067.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Eduardo García-Valdecasas, Matthew Reece, Motoo Suzuki. Gauge theories in d d dimensions with a nontrivial fundamental group admit a ( d − 3 ) (d-3) -form magnetic symmetry and a ( d − 5 ) (d-5) -form instantonic symmetry. These are examples of Chern-Weil symmetries, with conserved currents built out of the gauge field strength, which can only be explicitly broken through violations of the Bianchi identity.

arxiv-2504-03089.title: SLACK: Attacking LiDAR-based SLAM with Adversarial Point Injections
arxiv-2504-03089.creator: Prashant Kumar, Dheeraj Vattikonda, Kshitij Madhav Bhat, Kunal Dargan, Prem Kalra
arxiv-2504-03089.description: Abstract The widespread adoption of learning-based methods for the LiDAR makes autonomous vehicles vulnerable to adversarial attacks through adversarial point injections (PiJ) . It poses serious security challenges for navigation and map generation. Despite its critical nature, no major work exists that studies learning-based attacks on LiDAR-based SLAM.

arxiv-2506-06905.title: Meta-Adaptive Prompt Distillation for Few-Shot Visual Question Answering
arxiv-2506-06905.creator: Akash Gupta, Amos Storkey, Mirella Lapata
arxiv-2506-06905.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Akash Gupta, Amos Storkey, Mirella Lapata. Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) often rely on in-context learning (ICL) to perform new tasks with minimal supervision. However, ICL performance, especially in smaller LMMs, is inconsistent and does not always improve monotonically with increasing examples. We hypothesize that this occurs due to the LMM being overwhelmed by additional information present in the image embeddings, which is not required for the downstream task.

britannica-1911-sidmouth-henry-addington.title: Sidmouth, Henry Addington, 1st Viscount (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-sidmouth-henry-addington.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-sidmouth-henry-addington.description: Article 'Sidmouth, Henry Addington, 1st Viscount' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Owing to his friendship with William Pitt he turned his attention to politics, and after his election as member of parliament for Devizes in 1784 gave a silent but steady support to the ministry of his friend.

pmc-11453839.title: 8154 The Pro-Fibrotic Transcriptional Profile of Adipose Tissue in Insulin Resistant Individuals
pmc-11453839.creator: M Choi, A Abdellatif, D L Alba, S K Koliwad
pmc-11453839.description: Disclosure: M. Choi: None. A. Abdellatif: None. D.L. Alba: None. S.K. Koliwad: None. Introduction: Adipose tissue (AT) fibrosis is linked to AT dysfunction including insulin resistance, and individuals with type 2 diabetes (T2D) have higher AT fibrosis than do healthy individuals. However, the molecular pathways underlying the link between AT fibrosis and insulin resistance is not understood.

pmc-11496216.title: Exposure to green spaces and schizophrenia: a systematic review
pmc-11496216.creator: Louise Marcham, Lyn Ellett
pmc-11496216.description: The mental health benefits of exposure to green spaces are well known. This systematic review summarizes the evidence of green space exposure for people with schizophrenia spectrum disorders (SSDs), focusing on incidence and mental health outcomes, including mental health symptoms and health service use. The study was pre-registered (PROSPERO ID: CRD42023431954), and conducted according to PRISMA guidelines.

pmc-11505365.title: Functional Properties and Sensory Quality of Kombucha Analogs Based on Herbal Infusions
pmc-11505365.creator: Marta Czarnowska-Kujawska, Joanna Klepacka, Małgorzata Starowicz, Patrycja Lesińska
pmc-11505365.description: Traditionally, kombucha is produced by the fermentation of black or green tea infusions with the use of SCOBY (Symbiotic Culture of Bacteria and Yeasts). However, SCOBY exhibits the ability to ferment other substrates as well, which can be used to create novel products with new sensory and health-promoting properties.

pmc-11524719.title: The Effect of High Levels Carbohydrate on Intestinal Microbiota, Metabolites, and Health of Common Carp (Cyprinus carpio L.)
pmc-11524719.creator: Jinrui Xiong, Liping Yang, Luming Wang, Shaoyang Zhi, Mengjuan Zhao, Chunchu Xu, Leya Qu, Xiaorui Guo, Xiao Yan, Chaobin Qin, Guoxing Nie
pmc-11524719.description: Long-term consumption of high-carbohydrate feed may adversely affect intestinal health of fish; however, the underlying roles remain ambiguous. This study examined the effects of varying carbohydrate levels on the intestinal flora of common carp and assessed how microbial metabolites influence intestinal health.

pmc-11603667.title: Angular stable plate fixation provides favorable biomechanical stability in simulated T-shaped acetabular fractures: a biomechanical study
pmc-11603667.creator: Moritz F LODDE, Christoph KATTHAGEN, Matthias KLIMEK, Karl ABSHAGEN, Christian PEEZ, Arian GROßE-ALLERMANN, Michael J RASCHKE, Oliver RIESENBECK
pmc-11603667.description: Background and purposeThe treatment of acetabular fractures remains technically demanding. In the case of reduced bone quality or fracture morphology reducing the amount of bone available for fixation, locking plates should provide considerable advantages. The aim of the present study was to compare conventional and locking plate fixation.

pmc-11619093.title: Global longitudinal strain in pre-symptomatic patients with mutation for transthyretin amyloidosis
pmc-11619093.creator: Grazia Canciello, Stefano Tozza, Gaetano Todde, Maria Nolano, Felice Borrelli, Giovanni Palumbo, Raffaella Lombardi, Emanuele Cassano, Wanda Acampa, Giovanni Esposito, Fiore Manganelli, Maria Angela Losi
pmc-11619093.description: BackgroundHereditary transthyretin (ATTRv) amyloidosis is rare, autosomal dominant disease with a fatal outcome if left untreated. Early stages detection is crucial for intervention. We aimed identifying early indexes of cardiac involvement and their eventual correlation with neurological indexes, in pre-symptomatic subjects with TTR gene mutation.

pmc-11677000.title: A Systematic Review of Controlled Trials: Can Patient Adherence to Antibiotics Be Improved Through Pharmaceutical Communication-Based Interventions?
pmc-11677000.creator: Carla Pires, Majdi N Al-Hasan
pmc-11677000.description: Background: Patient adherence to antibiotics is vital to ensure treatment efficiency. Objective: To evaluate the impact of pharmacist communication-based interventions on patients’ adherence to antibiotics. Methods: A systematic review following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses for systematic review (PRISMA) checklist and flow diagram. Controlled trials were included. Databases: PubMed, Cochrane Library, SciELO, and Google Scholar.

pmc-11690098.title: PREDICTING TIME TO COGNITIVE IMPAIRMENT USING BRAIN AGE
pmc-11690098.creator: Phoebe Imms, Siyu Chen, Haoqing Wang, Ruixi Li, Andrei Irimia
pmc-11690098.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The neurological changes that occur during the asymptomatic pre-clinical phase of cognitive impairment (CI) can be quantified using brain age (BA) measures and leveraged to identify those at risk of clinical manifestation. We employ a machine learning survival model to predict future CI among healthy older adults using cognitive, demographic, genetic, and neuroimaging data including regional brain volume and anatomically specific measures of BA. Participants were 2,718 adults from NACC (1,795 females, mean age=69.14±10.91).

pmc-12538234.title: A Systematic Review of Ocular Complications Following Different Types of Covid‐19 Vaccines
pmc-12538234.creator: Bahareh Ebrahimi, Hossein Kargar Jahromi, Nazanin Shafiei Jahromi, Mina Molayem, Poorani Gurumallesh
pmc-12538234.description: IntroductionMore than 6 million deaths from the novel coronavirus, the Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID‐19) infection, have prompted the development of several prophylactic vaccines of COVID‐19. This systematic review summarizes the ocular complications of various COVID‐19 vaccinations, diseases diagnosed, treatment, and risk factors.MethodsThe search was done in PubMed, Web of Science (WOS), and Google Scholar databases.

pmc-12549267.title: Integrating transcriptomic and genomic studies for the identification of expression quantitative trait loci associated with bovine paratuberculosis
pmc-12549267.creator: Gerard Badia-Bringué, Marta Alonso-Hearn
pmc-12549267.description: The study of the genetic basis underlying the host response to Mycobacterium avium subsp. paratuberculosis (MAP) is usually performed using genome-wide association studies (GWAS), which assess the individual association between genotyped markers, typically single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), and phenotypic traits of interest (quantitative or qualitative).

pmc-13099549.title: Plant pathogenic nematode exosomes remodel vector tracheae to enhance pathogen transmission
pmc-13099549.creator: Yue Chang, Jiao Zhou, Fangyuan Ye, Hongxia Zhang, Jianghua Sun, Lilin Zhao
pmc-13099549.description: SignificancePathogen-driven manipulation of vector physiology represents a fundamental yet understudied survival strategy for optimizing transmission efficiency. This study reveals a sophisticated mechanism whereby the pinewood nematode utilizes exosome-mediated cross-kingdom transmission of miRNA to remodel the tracheal development of its carrier.

pmc-13176893.title: Early post‐operative outcomes in adults undergoing minimally invasive versus open emergency colorectal surgery: A retrospective cohort study of the ACS‐NSQIP 2016–2022
pmc-13176893.creator: Tyler McKechnie, Sara Keshavjee, Victoria Shi, Olivia Kuszaj, Sahaar Rattansi, Dennis Hong, Aristithes Doumouras, Cagla Eskicioglu
pmc-13176893.description: AimMinimally invasive surgery (MIS) has become common practice in elective colectomy; however, in emergent settings, this is less common and requires further research on safety and efficacy. The aim of this study was to compare MIS and open approaches for emergency colectomy.

pmc-13271031.title: Gastric Cancer-Associated Immunomodulatory Fibroblasts Persist Following Helicobacter pylori Eradication: The Need to Douse a Smoldering Fire
pmc-13271031.creator: Jennifer M Noto, Richard M Peek

pmc-13371865.title: Purple Urine Bag Syndrome in a 26-Year-Old Woman Living with HIV and Metastatic Spinal Cord Compression: A Case Report
pmc-13371865.creator: Vincent Wasswa, James Nelson Okema, Kim Andrew Otto, Kiragga Denis Lwembawo, Maria Gabriella Nampiinga, Irene Birungi, Michael Ndyomugabe, Ivaan Pitua
pmc-13371865.description: BackgroundPurple urine bag syndrome (PUBS) is a rare complication of urinary catheterization in which urine, catheter and collection bag develop a characteristic purple discoloration from bacterial metabolism of dietary tryptophan to indigo and indirubin. It is reported almost exclusively in elderly, chronically catheterized women, with very few reports from sub-Saharan Africa.

pmc-13530815.title: Poster 241. Outcomes of Operative and Non-Operative Midshaft Clavicle Fractures in a Young and Athletic Population
pmc-13530815.creator: Houston Dove, Campbell Aiken, Eva Dreiling, Morgan Russell, Gabby West, Alex Yates, Matthew P. Ithurburn, Christopher H. Garrett, Marcus A. Rothermich, Benton A. Emblom, E. Lyle Cain, Jeffrey R. Dugas

pmc-13594721.title: Bioorthogonal aggregation-induced emission nanoprobes for targeted photodynamic eradication of Gram-negative pathogens in periodontitis
pmc-13594721.creator: Shisheng Cao, Cailing Zhao, Surong Guo, Jiashen Hu, Qing Yang, Xin Li, Yiping Liu, Dan Ding, Huijuan Yin, Juan Zhang
pmc-13594721.description: Periodontitis is a bacteria-driven immune–inflammatory disease associated with progressive periodontal tissue destruction and alveolar bone loss. Conventional treatments rely heavily on broad-spectrum antibiotics, which can promote antimicrobial resistance and disrupt the oral microbiota. Herein, we report a bioorthogonal aggregation-induced emission (AIE)-based nanoprobe, AIE@PEG-DBCO, designed for the selective imaging and photodynamic elimination of Gram-negative periodontal pathogens.

pmc-3689523.title: How good are my data and what is the resolution?
pmc-3689523.creator: Philip R. Evans, Garib N. Murshudov
pmc-3689523.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). The new scaling program AIMLESS is described and tests of refinements at different resolutions are compared with analyses from the scaling step.
